tools.name: get_property_detail
tools.description: Get the complete record of one listing in Portugal by its slug. Use this after search_properties when the user asks about a specific property: full description, features, photos, energy rating, condition, floor, year built, seller and the original source URL to cite.

tools.name: search_neighbourhoods
tools.description: Search neighbourhood and municipality guides for Portugal, with median price per m² for buying and renting, price trend and an editorial summary. Use this when the user asks where to live or where to buy, or wants to compare areas, instead of asking for individual listings.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search editorial articles about the property market in Portugal: buying and renting guides, market analysis and practical advice. Use this when the user asks how something works — mortgages, contracts, taxes, the buying process — rather than asking for listings.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_properties" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Search current residential, rural and commercial real-estate listings for sale or rent in Portugal. Use this whenever the user wants to find, compare or explore…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_properties, get_property_detail · Private data: get_property_detail · Public sink: search_properties.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_properties, get_property_detail · Private data: get_property_detail · Public sink: search_properties

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
